g1.label: 1. What time does the workshop start?
g1.why: The recording says the workshop starts at one fifteen.

g2.label: 2. Where is the workshop?
g2.why: The recording says the workshop takes place in the library.

g3.why: The recording says Ms Carter is an expert from a local police team.

g4.why: The recording says students should bring their own phone or tablet, not laptops.

g5.why: The recording says to put your name on the list in the school office before Monday.

g7.why: Sam says he blocked the account but did not tell anyone.

g1.label: 1. Jonas — one password everywhere
g1.why: The text says you should never use the same password twice.

g2.label: 2. Priya — public profile
g2.why: The text says to set your profile to private so only friends can look at it.

g3.label: 3. Tom — picture of a classmate
g3.why: The text says to always ask before you post a photo of someone else.

g4.label: 4. Ella — rude message
g4.why: The text says to block the account, report it and tell an adult.

g5.label: 5. Club meets after school
g5.why: The text says the club meets at lunchtime.

g6.label: 6. Members pay a fee
g6.why: The text says the club is free.

g7.label: 7. No sign-up needed
g7.why: The text says you do not need to sign up.

g8.label: 8. Monthly poster
